map.EULAR干燥综合征疾病活动指数（ESSDAI），12个器官系统加权评分，评估全: EULAR Sjogren's Syndrome Disease Activity Index (ESSDAI), weighted score of 12 organ systems, assesses systemic organ involvement activity
map.根据各器官系统当前活动度选择分级（0=无活动，1=低，2=中，3=高），系统自动: Select a grade per organ system by current activity (0=none, 1=low, 2=moderate, 3=high), the system auto-weights
map.12 系统下拉逐项：淋巴结2+肺2+肾(权重4)+血液1+关节1+皮肤1+外周神: 12 systems dropdown: lymph node 2 + lung 2 + renal (weight 4) + hematologic 1 + articular 1 + skin 1 + peripheral nerve 1 + central 1 + glandular 1 = 14, >=14 is high activity, suggests systemic immunosuppression.
map.合计 3（如关节1+皮肤1+腺体1）→ 低活动，对症为主。: Total 3 (e.g. articular 1 + skin 1 + glandular 1) -> low activity, symptomatic mainly.
map.本页为评分式（assessor），essdai 为展示式，计分规则一致。: This page is scoring (assessor), essdai is display, scoring rules identical.
map.肾、肺、神经等系统「高」级取该域权重分（如肾权重 4），其余低/中/高=1/2/: Renal, pulmonary, nervous etc. 'high' grade takes that domain's weight (e.g. renal weight 4), others low/mod/high = 1/2/weight.
map.本工具基于 EULAR 干燥综合征疾病活动指数（ESSDAI），纯前端运行，数据: This tool is based on EULAR Sjogren's Disease Activity Index (ESSDAI), runs entirely in-browser, data is not uploaded to any server
map.ESSDAI含12个器官系统域，各域权重不同（1-5），活动度0-3级，总分最高: ESSDAI has 12 organ-system domains with different weights (1-5), activity 0-3 levels, max total ~96
map.本工具供临床评估参考，治疗决策需结合风湿免疫科医师综合判断: This tool is for clinical assessment reference; treatment decisions need comprehensive judgment by a rheumatologist
